audience: a parent or patient-group leader without medical training

sentences.text: Mucopolysaccharidosis type 6 is linked to the gene ARSB in curated databases [e_d7fc6c6ed56b].
Mucopolysaccharidosis type 3 is linked to the genes GNS and HGSNAT only by inference from subtypes, each with confidence 0.475, and this may not hold for every form [e_31e8d8274b07] [e_ed375158e5b0].
Constellate computed that types 6 and 3 look somewhat alike in their listed symptoms, with a score of 0.281, which is inferred and not a diagnosis [e_89b3b1a97b62].
For type 6, a growth plate problem and a short trunk with short height are listed as curated, very frequent features [e_930197febd65] [e_688d8420d52d].
Intellectual disability is marked as contradicted for type 6, with 1 contradicting record [e_463d5bddc92d].
For type 3, a gene therapy study is listed as not yet recruiting and a cannabidiol study as recruiting [e_293f8f633c73] [e_1246a2f623f5].
A patient group is matched to type 3, but only by a name match on its website [e_a1a9b68fc263].
These edges list no study for type 6 and do not show results of any study [e_d7fc6c6ed56b].
